newsitem.title: ISRAEL: KFC to open restaurant in Gaza.
newsitem.headline: KFC to open restaurant in Gaza.

text.p: Palestinian-ruled Gaza will get its first American fast food outlet next month when a Kentucky Fried Chicken restaurant opens near the beach in Gaza City, the franchise holder said Wednesday.
"Chicken is very popular and close to Middle Eastern food," Gazan businessman Haidar Abu Karsh said. The restaurant will serve chicken raised in Gaza but will import KFC's spices from Egypt.
Abu Karsh bought the franchise with two partners through an Egyptian company for $200,000 and said he has already sent employees to Egypt for training.
Israel handed over most of the Gaza Strip to Palestinian self-rule in 1994.
PepsiCo Inc. said last month that it would spin off its restaurant operations, including KFC, by distributing shares to existing shareholders.
